traceability.notes:
The story 026.0-DEV-ELSE-IF-ANNOTATION-POSITION is not implemented.
Key gaps vs. acceptance criteria and requirements:
1. **REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION-ELSE-IF / REQ-FALLBACK-LOGIC-ELSE-IF / REQ-POSITION-PRIORITY-ELSE-IF** - `gatherBranchCommentText` only has special behavior for `SwitchCase` and `CatchClause`. For `IfStatement` (including else-if nodes), it only inspects comments returned by `sourceCode.getCommentsBefore(node)` and returns that text. - There is no logic to detect that an `IfStatement` is part of an else-if chain (`parent.alternate === node`) or to scan comments between `else if (condition)` and the corresponding branch body. - There is no “position priority” behavior that prefers comments before the `else` when both positions have annotations; the code simply uses one text blob from `gatherBranchCommentText` and tests it for `@story`/`@req`. - Therefore, dual-position detection and fallback logic for else-if annotations have not been implemented.
2. **REQ-PRETTIER-AUTOFIX-ELSE-IF / Auto-Fix Compatibility** - `getBranchAnnotationInfo` adjusts indent and `insertPos` only for `CatchClause` to allow insertion inside the catch body (implemented for Story 025.0). - For `IfStatement` (including else-if), `indent` is derived from the line of the `if` node and `insertPos` is set to the start of that line, meaning auto-fix inserts annotations immediately before the `if`/`else if` line. - There is no logic to choose a Prettier-stable insertion point (e.g., between the condition and the body for wrapped else-if statements), nor any conditional behavior driven by whether the statement is an else-if. - No tests exercise or verify Prettier-stable auto-fix for else-if branches.
3. **Prettier Compatibility & Tests** - The test suite has targeted tests for catch-annotation positioning and auto-fix (Story 025.0) but nothing analogous for else-if. - `tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts` covers `if`, loops, `switch`, `try/catch`, and nested `if` branches, but does not include any `else if` examples or comments placed between `else if (condition)` and the body. - There are no integration tests that run Prettier on code containing else-if chains and then validate that `require-branch-annotation` passes without manual changes.
4. **No Regression / Other Branch Types** - Existing tests for if/else and other branch types are passing (as confirmed by the Jest run), but this only confirms current behavior remains intact; it does not show the new else-if behavior exists.
5. **Documentation Acceptance Criterion** - The user docs in `user-docs/api-reference.md` describe `traceability/require-branch-annotation` generically and do not mention: - two valid annotation positions for else-if branches, - Prettier compatibility specifics for else-if, or - any new configuration or behavior relating to Story 026.0. - No other user-doc files appear to document this story’s behavior.
6. **Traceability & Test References** - No code comments or tests reference `docs/stories/026.0-DEV-ELSE-IF-ANNOTATION-POSITION.story.md` or its requirement IDs. All relevant branch-annotation utilities and rule tests are still tied to Story 004.0 and, for catch behavior, Story 025.0.
Because the core else-if detection fallback, Prettier-stable auto-fix behavior, targeted tests, and documentation updates are all missing, this story is not yet implemented. The appropriate status for this specification is FAILED.
